messages:
Ravi S: Cerulean asked for a joint HW bench focused on perf/W and tail latency under power caps. They want three power caps (60W/75W/90W), two quant modes, and DVFS knobs toggled. also they'd like a single-slide summary for marketplace listing.

Nora T: sounds good. i'll coordinate the comms template for the marketplace blurb. can we get a defined CSV schema for the bench outputs so their marketing and eng teams can ingest?

Ivan G: I can produce a schema. minimal fields: run_id, node_id, batch, seq_len, quant, power_cap, avg_watt, p50_ms, p95_ms, throughput_seq_s, kv_hit_pct, kernel_flags. CSV + ndjson traces.

Maya R: from ops side, we'll need a stable BIOS + microcode baseline. also request that Cerulean provide the vendor kernel version they run in prod. we should mirror that on the control nodes. :gear: 

Ravi S: agreed. plan: 8 nodes total - 2 control (vendor kernel), 6 testing (3 power caps * 2 quant modes) rotated across DVFS settings. each job will run batches [1,2,4] seq 1024. target window 2h per config so we get steady-state.

Ivan G: draft harness command (feel free to tweak):

```bash
./run_bench --model camel-7b --batch 1,2,4 --seq 1024 --quant q8,q4
  --power-cap 60,75,90 --dvfs auto,performance,powersave \
  --kernel-flags "noprefetch=1;hugepages=on" \
  --telemetry nvml,rapl,pmu --telemetry-interval 200 \
  --out s3://redwood-partner-bench/cerulean/<run>/ \n  --trace-format ndjson
```

Nora T: for the marketplace slide, Cerulean wants a 1-line highlight (e.g., "Up to 1.7x perf/W vs vendor baseline") + a small chart. we'll only draft the claim after stats pass significance checks.

Maya R: bench-bot can schedule next Mon at 08:00 UTC. should we also capture ambient rack temp and inlet? small differences change perf/W.

Ravi S: yes capture temps. also include a run with kernel debug symbols to collect perf maps for root-cause analysis.

bench-bot: scheduled run cerulean-20260427-01 across 8 nodes starting 2026-04-27T08:00:00Z. live logs at https://bench.redwood.internal/cerulean-20260427-01

Ivan G: uploaded CSV schema to s3://redwood-partner-bench/cerulean/schema/v1.csv and put example plots in the repo.

Maya R: provisioning done. BIOS pinned, microcode set to 2026-03-02, control nodes on vendor-kernel-5.18.4. kicking off warmup now.

bench-bot: job cerulean-20260427-01/1 completed: batch=1 quant=q8 power_cap=75 avg_watt=74.2 p50=28.7 p95=61.4 throughput=9.5 kv_hit=0.87. artifacts -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/cerulean/cerulean-20260427-01/results/part-0001.jsonl

Ivan G: quick glance: under power cap 75W, our tuned kernel (noprefetch=1 hugepages=on) reduced p95 by ~12% and gained ~6% throughput vs vendor kernel. will run statistical tests across nodes.

Ravi S: great. Nora, i'll send preliminary numbers and a draft single-slide for review. Let's keep any claim gated on p<0.05.

Nora T: thanks. once stats clear, i'll prepare the marketplace blurb and coordinate the joint press cadence with Cerulean comms. target internal review in 48h after final stats.

Maya R: Also note: we saw one noisy node with elevated inlet temp; flagged for retest. I'll isolate its runs from the summary.

bench-bot: job cerulean-20260427-01/5 failed (node-7): dmesg shows GPU ECC recovery events. logs -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/cerulean/cerulean-20260427-01/node-7-dmesg.log

Ivan G: removing node-7 from aggregated CSV and rerunning that config on a spare node. will post updated aggregates when ready.

Ravi S: action items: Ivan (stats + updated aggregates), Maya (retest node-7 and confirm temps), Nora (marketplace slide draft). Meeting planned Thu 15:00 UTC to finalize comms. Thanks team. :tada:
